SAMPLE SIZE.evidence_source: The mean CAQ score at Time 1 for the 53 students who participated in both trials was 16.7 (SD = 11.6, minimum score = 1, maximum = 47). Mean CAQ score at Time 2 was 14.2 (SD = 10.6, minimum = 0, maximum = 54). Mean number of days between test times 1 and 2 was 51.3 (SD = 12.6, minimum = 14, maximum = 120). The 96 items on the CAQ were tested across the Time 1 scores of the 117 participants to examine internal consistency.

ES.warning: The correlation coefficient of .81 is for test-retest reliability of the CAQ, not between intelligence and creative achievement, so it is not extracted as an effect size.

Effects.evidence_source: No correlation coefficients between intelligence and creative achievement were found in the text.

Creativity Measures.evidence_source: The mean CAQ score of all participants in the study was 14.4 (SD = 11.4, minimum score = 0, maximum score = 47). The mean CAQ score at Time 1 for the 53 students who participated in both trials was 16.7 (SD = 11.6, minimum score = 1, maximum = 47). Mean CAQ score at Time 2 was 14.2 (SD = 10.6, minimum = 0, maximum = 54). The 96 items on the CAQ were tested across the Time 1 scores of the 117 participants to examine internal consistency. The internal consistency rating for the CAQ as a whole was α = .96, indicating strong internal reliability.

section_summary.extract_value: This section presents the results regarding the reliability and internal consistency of the Creativity Achievement Questionnaire (CAQ). It reports a test-retest reliability coefficient of .81 for 53 students and an overall internal consistency (alpha) of .96 for the CAQ as a whole, based on 117 participants. The section also mentions split-half reliabilities and that internal consistency ratings for each of the 10 domains are presented in Table 1.
